headline: Hoax bomb threats disrupt several flights across Europe; no explosives found
headline_es: Falsas amenazas de bomba alteran varios vuelos en Europa; no se hallaron explosivos
caption_es: Falsas amenazas de bomba afectaron el martes a varios vuelos en Europa, entre ellos servicios de Ryanair, LOT y SAS con destino a Roma, Varsovia y Murcia. El aeropuerto de Varsovia-Modlin cerró temporalmente y cazas italianos escoltaron un avión de Ryanair hasta Roma-Fiumicino. Las inspecciones no hallaron explosivos y todos los aviones aterrizaron sin problemas.
caption_en: False bomb threats targeted several flights across Europe on Tuesday, including Ryanair, LOT and SAS services bound for Rome, Warsaw and Murcia. Warsaw Modlin airport closed temporarily and Italian fighter jets escorted a Ryanair plane into Rome Fiumicino. Searches found no explosives and all the planes landed safely.
summary_es: Vuelos de Ryanair, LOT y SAS fueron objeto de amenazas falsas; Varsovia-Modlin cerró temporalmente y no se hallaron explosivos.
summary_en: Ryanair, LOT and SAS flights were hit by false threats; Warsaw Modlin closed briefly and no explosives were found.
